description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'MatcherTest' that tests various functionalities of the 'Matcher' class within the Goteo project. It includes setup, creation, validation, management of users, projects, languages, and rewards associated with matchers, as well as delete and cleanup operations.

classes.name: MatcherTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Matcher entity within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run; configures language settings.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Matcher class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Validates a new Matcher instance.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates and retrieves a Matcher, testing persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: testVars
methods.description: Tests setting and getting variables on the Matcher.

methods.name: testMatchesRewards
methods.description: Checks if Matcher correctly identifies reward matches.

methods.name: testActivateMatchingRewards
methods.description: Activates matching rewards feature.

methods.name: testMatchesRewardsAfterActivation
methods.description: Verifies rewards matching after activation.

methods.name: testGetZeroMatchingRewards
methods.description: Ensures no rewards are matching initially.

methods.name: testAddMatchingReward
methods.description: Adds a reward to the matcher.

methods.name: testDeactivateMatchingRewards
methods.description: Deactivates reward matching.

methods.name: testGetNoMatchingRewards
methods.description: Confirms no rewards are currently matching.

methods.name: testAddUsers
methods.description: Associates users with the Matcher and verifies total amounts.

methods.name: testChangeUserPool
methods.description: Modifies user pools associated with the Matcher.

methods.name: testAddProjects
methods.description: Associates projects with the Matcher.

methods.name: testChangeProjects
methods.description: Modifies project associations with the Matcher.

methods.name: testRemoveUsers
methods.description: Removes users from the Matcher.

methods.name: testRemoveProjects
methods.description: Removes projects from the Matcher.

methods.name: testSaveLanguages
methods.description: Saves language translations for the matcher.

methods.name: testCheckLanguages
methods.description: Checks if language translations are correctly loaded.

methods.name: testListing
methods.description: Tests listing of matchers, including language-specific versions.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes a matcher and verifies deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a non-existent matcher returns null.

methods.name: testCleanUsers
methods.description: Cleans up test user data from the database.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleanup after all tests run; deletes test data.
